verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for an agent framework, but the evidence never shows a scheduler, cron trigger, or recurring-run capability in ADK. The graph-based Workflow Runtime supports loops, retry and orchestration within a single execution. That is a one-off run, not a recurring schedule. Deployment to Cloud Run, GKE or Agent Runtime is host-platform infrastructure and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
